title: THE CLIMB · LADDER LAPS
vibe: 45 min · green · hard · 3 laps, 5 loaded stations, reps climb every lap, legs get faster every lap
why: Yesterday was two passes of a chipper, so today is an ascending ladder: 3 laps of 5 loaded stations, reps go 8, 12, 16 and every station exits onto a 0.15 mi leg. Snatch, high pull, hinge, squat and press all loaded, running on flooded legs.

blocks.title: WARM-UP · 5 MIN · ONE PASS
blocks.meta: Moves Method Day B · ankles, knees, shoulders for the snatch

items.name: Toe squats 30s · ankle rolls in the squat ×10/side
Side step-ups ×8/side · 50 lb DB snatch ×3/side easy

blocks.title: THE CLIMB · 30 MIN · ASCENDING LADDER
blocks.meta: 3 LAPS · 5 STATIONS · 15 RUN LEGS · 2×40 lb · 50 lb · cap 30:00
blocks.format: LADDER · lap 1 = 8 reps per station · lap 2 = 12 · lap 3 = 16 (unilateral: per side is half) · every station exits onto a 0.15 mi leg · one clock · count laps, then time
blocks.workRest: Legs are 0.15 mi flat. LAP 1 legs @ 7.5. LAP 2 legs @ 8.0. LAP 3 legs @ 8.5. Set the lap speed once, leave it.

items.name: S1 · Double high pull 2×40 lb ×8 / 12 / 16 → RUN LEG
S2 · Bear-hug squat 50 lb ×8 / 12 / 16 → RUN LEG
items.detail: dumbbell hugged vertical to the chest, full depth

items.name: S3 · DB snatch 50 lb ×8 / 12 / 16 (half per arm) → RUN LEG
S4 · Kickstand RDL 50 lb ×8 / 12 / 16 (half per leg) → RUN LEG
items.detail: back toe down, bell in the opposite hand

items.name: S5 · Double floor press 2×40 lb ×8 / 12 / 16 → RUN LEG

blocks.noteGreen: Log laps finished + time, RPE, and whether 8.5 held for all five lap-3 legs.
blocks.text: ★ HIGH PULL — hike, snap the hips, elbows high and wide to chest height, bells back down the same path. ★ KICKSTAND RDL — 80% on the front leg, hinge to the shin, hips square. ★ FLOOR PRESS — elbows touch the floor every rep. ★ RUN LEG — step on moving, quick feet, find the stride by the end of the leg.
